Summary of Product Characteristics (draft, sections 1 to 6)

Lorvantine 250 mg film-coated tablets

Read all of this leaflet carefully before you start taking this medicine, because it contains important information for you.

1. What this medicine is and what it is used for

This medicine is taken once a day, as your doctor has told you. Each tablet contains 250 mg of the active substance.

5. How to store this medicine

2.3 Quality Overall Summary

This summary follows the structure of Module 3 for Lorvantine 250 mg film-coated tablets.

The formulation uses a direct compression process with common excipients. The tablets were shown to have a dissolution profile similar to the reference product in three media.

2.3.P.8 Stability

The stability data support the storage conditions and the shelf life proposed in Module 3.2.P.8.

The site holds a current certificate of good manufacturing practice, number HL-GMP-0193.

Direct compression of the blend, followed by tablet compression, film coating and blister packing. In-process controls are listed in section 3.2.P.3.4.

Stability report: Lorvantine 250 mg film-coated tablets

Contents

3.2.P.8.3 Stability data ........ page 3

3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion

Three primary batches of Lorvantine 250 mg film-coated tablets were placed on stability in the proposed commercial pack. All results stayed within specification at every time point. Based on these data, a shelf life of 36 months is proposed when the product is stored below 30 C in the original package.

3.2.P.8.3 Stability data

Table 1. Storage conditions and duration of data

| Study | Storage condition | Temperature (C) | Relative humidity (%) | Months of data |
| Long-term | 30 C / 65% RH | 30 | 65 | 24 |
| Accelerated | 40 C / 75% RH | 40 | 75 | 6 |

The long-term study was stored at 30 C / 65% RH. 24 months of long-term data are available for all three batches.

Assay, related substances and dissolution met the acceptance criteria at every time point.

3.2.P.8.2 Post-approval stability commitment and protocol

The applicant commits to continue the long-term study on the three primary batches up to the end of the proposed shelf life, and to place one production batch of Lorvantine 250 mg film-coated tablets per year on stability.

The protocol will be updated if a storage condition or a test method changes.

4.2 Nonclinical overview

The active substance of Lorvantine 250 mg film-coated tablets is the same as that of the reference medicinal product, which has a long record of use. No new nonclinical studies were performed for this application. The overview refers to the published literature on the pharmacology and toxicology of the active substance.

5.3.1 Bioequivalence study report (summary)

A single-dose, two-period crossover study in healthy adult volunteers compared Lorvantine 250 mg film-coated tablets with the reference medicinal product under fasting conditions. The 90% confidence intervals for the ratio of the geometric means of AUC and Cmax fell within the acceptance range of 80.00% to 125.00%.
